name: Marian Goodman Gallery
about_text: Marian Goodman Gallery was established in New York in 1977 by Marian Goodman, who had earlier co-founded the art-publishing house Multiples, Inc. The gallery became known for introducing major European artists to American audiences and later expanded internationally, opening a Paris location in 1995 and, for a period from 2014 to 2022, a London space. In September 2023 the gallery inaugurated a permanent exhibition space in Los Angeles, extending a program that now anchors both U.S. coasts alongside its long-running Paris presence. The gallery represents more than fifty artists and estates across generations, with a program emphasizing rigorous, institutionally engaged practices in painting, sculpture, photography, film, and performance, and maintains close, long-term collaborations with its artists and with curators and institutions worldwide.
